newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand plans crackdown on palm oil smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Thailand plans crackdown on palm oil smuggling.

text.p: Thai Commerce Minister Chucheep Hansawat said on Thursday that his ministry would launch a crackdown on rampant palm oil smuggling.

He blamed the smuggling of the oil into the country, mostly from major producer Malaysia, for a drop in local palm oil prices. He gave no details about the quantities smuggled or how the oil was brought into Thailand.
Chucheep estimated that Thai palm fruit output would be 450,000 tonnes this year and 500,000 tonnes next year.

"We need cooperation from private sector to tip us off... If the crackdown campaign is successful, local prices will improve and in case of shortages, we can manage the supply more efficiently," he said.
Industry sources said Malaysian palm oil costs around 11.50 baht (US$0.46) a kg while local palm oil prices were running at around 14.50 baht. ($1 = 25 baht)
